notes: Capability-focused StepFun technical report (architecture, pre/post-train, multimodal and text benches). No dedicated safety, risk-threshold, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, cyber, or bio section. Only safety-relevant numeric eval is HallusionBench (Tables 1 and 3). Behavioral Regularization during RLHF claims to mitigate reward hacking and hallucinations (citation verification, epistemic calibration) without measured rates—reward_hacking left uncovered (training method only). Skipped all capability benches: MMMU, MathVista/Vision/Verse, MMBench, MMStar, SimpleVQA, MMVP, counting, OCR, spatial, GUI, MMLU-Pro, GPQA, AIME, LiveCodeBench, IFEval, Arena-Hard, WildBench, HealthBench, and related. Open-source claimed; no license name or calendar release date. Figure 1 chart numbers skipped (tables cover HallusionBench). Seed-linked model stepfun-ai/Step3-VL-10B is covered.
